# Agent Skill Library

Experimental declarative skill package contract and validator.

- Read README.md for scope and limitations.
- Read docs/SKILL-CONTRACT.md for package and workflow semantics.
- Read docs/THREAT-MODEL.md before consuming untrusted skills.
- Validate an example: python tools/validate_skill.py examples/echo
- Run tests: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
- Workflow schema: schemas/skill-workflow.schema.json
- Resource metadata contract: https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-resource-manifest
- Master registry: https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem

This repository does not execute skills, authenticate publishers, enforce policy, or provide sandbox isolation.
